## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility considerations.
Link the related issue, especially for a substantial feature or API change.

## Validation

List the focused checks run and their results. For simulation changes, state
the assumptions, comparison evidence, and limits of the claim.

## Submission Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including the release
      integration process, licensing, and commercial reuse terms.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under the project license and
      have obtained any necessary rights-holder permission.
- [ ] I have identified incorporated third-party material, sources, licenses,
      and required notices, or there is no such material.
- [ ] Each contribution commit includes my DCO sign-off, as required by the
      policy for new submissions. A checklist tick does not replace a sign-off.
- [ ] This PR contains no secrets, confidential or restricted material, private
      report packets, or unrelated generated outputs.

## Attribution

Identify collaborators and any incorporated or inspiring prior contributions.
If coauthor credit applies, provide the public name and account-associated
email address they have chosen; a GitHub no-reply address is acceptable.
